Class Templates

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.web.Templates
@CheckedTemplate final class Templates extends Object
The fragments index.html swaps into itself. Each method is a template in templates/, and the build checks that every expression in it exists on the parameter types.
